<style>
  .about-hero {

  }
  
  .timeline::before {
    content: '';
    position: absolute;
    left: 0;
    top: 0;
    bottom: 0;
    width: 2px;
    background: #64a19d;
  }
  
  .timeline-item {
    position: relative;
    margin-bottom: 2rem;
    padding-left: 2rem;
  }
  
  .timeline-item::before {
    content: '';
    position: absolute;
    left: -0.5rem;
    top: 0.5rem;
    width: 1rem;
    height: 1rem;
    background: #64a19d;
    border-radius: 50%;
    border: 3px solid white;
    box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px #64a19d;
  }
  
  .timeline-title {
    font-size: 1.2rem;
    font-weight: 600;
    color: #333;
    margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
  }
  
  .timeline-subtitle {
    color: #64a19d;
    font-weight: 500;
    margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
  }
  
  .timeline-date {

  }
  
  .timeline-description {
    color: #666;
    line-height: 1.6;
  }
  
  .skills-highlight {
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    gap: 0.5rem;
    margin-top: 1rem;
  }
  
  .skill-badge {
    background: #f8f9fa;
    color: #64a19d;
    padding: 0.25rem 0.75rem;
    border-radius: 20px;
    font-size: 0.8rem;
    font-weight: 500;
    border: 1px solid #e9ecef;
  }
  
  .contact-section {
    background: #f8f9fa;
    padding: 4rem 0;
  }
  
  .contact-card {
    background: white;
    border-radius: 10px;
    padding: 1.5rem;
    text-align: center;
    box-shadow: 0 3px 10px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1);
    transition: transform 0.3s ease;
  }
  
  .contact-card:hover {
    transform: translateY(-3px);
  }
  
  .contact-icon {
    font-size: 2rem;
    color: #64a19d;
    margin-bottom: 1rem;
  }
  
  .contact-title {
    font-size: 1.1rem;
    font-weight: 600;
    margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
    color: #333;
  }
  
  .contact-info {
    color: #666;
  }
  
  .contact-link {
    color: #64a19d;
    text-decoration: none;
  }
  
  .contact-link:hover {
    color: #50817e;

</style>
